title: Apocope
summary: APOC'OPE, APOC'OPY, noun [Gr. abscission, of and to cut.] The cutting off, or omission of the last letter or syllable of a word; as di for dii.

inlines.v: APOC'OPE, APOC'OPY, noun [Gr. abscission, of and to cut.] The cutting off, or omission of the last letter or syllable of a word; as di for dii.
